value.rationale: For an actually published positive-semidefinite-preserving Lyapunov integration scheme, the precise stationary bias has a nontrivial forcing-correlation phase boundary. The result distinguishes guaranteed positive output from upper covariance bounds, with an all-step rank-one obstruction and explicit small/large-step behavior. This is a complete natural two-mode classification relevant to stationary controllability/uncertainty covariances, not an isolated unmotivated algebraic sign example.
